messages:
olivia: Quick sync — putting up a lightweight proposal for conditional onboarding to reserved pools. Goal: let smaller customers get reserved behavior (soft burst + quota) if they meet onboarding gates instead of full contract. Need launch acceptance criteria and engineering scope estimates.

sam: curious — is this a billing product change or just routing/quotas?

olivia: routing + quota policy + onboarding workflow. billing footprint optional for GA (we can handshake via sales for invoiced customers).

priya: from ops POV we need clear SLOs and prewarm rules. soft-burst leaking into shared pools was our biggest past problem.

jordan: sales + AE perspective: customers ask for predictable latency without long commitments. if we can offer a 3-month trial with soft guarantees, it helps close deals. we need simple terms.

mike: CS report: 4 inbound requests last quarter asking to "try reserved" without signing year-long. often they want predictable 95th pct latency, not throughput.

anya: solutioning: propose two tracks: "Trial Reserve" (time-limited, quota capped, lower SLA) and "Commit Reserve" (paid, stronger SLA). Trial should auto-expire.

sam: engineering questions: how do we enforce Trial caps? easiest is a per-tenant token bucket + admission priority. if trial tenant exceeds cap, route to hosted models with higher cost (or throttle).

priya: agree. we can implement a policy that: (a) limits sustained concurrency, (b) marks pool priority low, (c) preempt after X mins. need to pick X.

olivia: suggested gating/launch criteria for GA (first pass):
- Feature: Trial Reserve onboarding flow in Console + API
- Policy: per-tenant trial quota (tokens/day), soft burst allowance (percent over baseline), auto-expire after 90d
- Observability: token-level cost + latency dashboard per trial tenant
- Safety: automatic fallback to best-effort routing if shared occupancy > 80%
- Docs & legal: trial T&Cs + customer messaging

jordan: timelines? sales needs this for 3 target pilots next month. GA in 8 weeks would be perfect.

sam: rough eng estimate: 3 wks for quota+admission core, 2 wks for routing + fallback, 1 wk for console + docs + tests = 6 wks if no major blockers. +1 wk for opt rollout. so 7 wks. need oncall support plan.

priya: add 1 wk for safe-mode rollback instrumentation and chaos tests. so realistic 8 wks.

olivia: good — acceptance tests we should require before GA:
- Can onboard a trial tenant and observe quota enforcement (create tenant, hit until quota, confirm fallback)
- Preemptive routing triggers at occupant >80% and respects trial priority
- Billing/usage export shows trial label and zero committed invoice
- Regression: no measurable impact (p95 latency) on existing dedicated customers (>+5ms threshold)

sam: can we automate the first two as e2e scenarios? yes. recommend harness with synthetic traffic profile (bursty chat + moderate seq gen).

anya: also include customer-facing sample language for trial limits and expiration. keep it simple: "Trial Reserve: 90 days, X requests/day, burst up to 2x for 5 min windows". no legalese.

jordan: sales asks for an escape hatch to convert trial to paid without data loss. ensure tenant id mapping preserved and routing policy can flip flag.

sam: implementation note: routing flag is a tenant tag. flip = immediate priority bump in admission. requires no model reload.

priya: ops checklist: alert if (a) trial tenant preempts twice in 24h, (b) shared pool occupancy >85% for 10 min, (c) trial conversion rate <5% for pilot customers (CS metric).

olivia: risk table (very high level):
- Risk: trials cause noisy neighbors -> Mitigation: strict soft quotas + preempt policy + occupancy fallback
- Risk: unclear customer expectations -> Mitigation: console messaging + email + CS handoff
- Risk: billing leakage -> Mitigation: usage label & export + sales handshake for conversion

ops-bot: deploy plan stub created: https://deploys.redwood/internal/plan/4521 (automated: will post updates)

mike: for pilots, recommend 3 customers: two small-mid SaaS, one platform team. CS will own handoff + weekly check-ins.

olivia: decision points we need here:
1) GA criteria approval (above)
2) Quota defaults: what X requests/day and burst multiplier?
3) Timeline sign-off (team commits to 8 wks?)

sam: proposal: default quota = 50k tokens/day, burst = 2x for 5 min windows, sustained throttle after 5 min.

priya: I prefer tokens/day param but set burst to 1.5x to be conservative. ops will tune during pilot.

jordan: sales asks for 100k token/day as optional high-trial for strategic pilot (manual enable).

olivia: ok: defaults: 50k/day, burst 1.5x(5m); pilot overrides to 100k for strategic customers.

olivia: next steps: sam + priya to scope epics & break into tickets, anya to draft console copy + email templates, jordan + mike to pick pilots. I'll file roadmap PR with tentative dates.

sam: i'll add a spike for admission policy (2d).

priya: i'll schedule chaos test slot with eng-sre in 3 weeks.

jordan: i'll share pilot candidate list by EOD tomorrow.

mike: CS will prepare onboarding checklist and kickoff doc.

olivia: thanks — if everyone ok with GA criteria & quotas as above, i'll mark as approved and push to sprint planning. react with :thumbsup: to approve or comment for objections.
